plugins.name: agent-graph
plugins.description: Live tool-call graph and run replay for AI coding harnesses (Claude Code, Codex).

plugins.name: agent-notch-tile
plugins.description: Notch tile for AI coding harnesses: waiting-for-input badge, active harness and phase, live subagent count, today's token usage, and the local provider's GPU VRAM claim.

plugins.name: dev-notch-tile
plugins.description: Notch tile for the Dev profile: the open project, its lifecycle phase, any resource claims it holds, and a badge when a lockfile has fallen behind its manifest.

plugins.name: llm-fit
plugins.description: Recommends local models your GPU can actually run, from llmfit's hardware scan, with one-click pull into Ollama.

cli.summary: Hardware-aware model recommendations via llmfit (default top 3)

plugins.name: gaming
plugins.description: Desktop-shell coordination around a running game: gamemode detection, do-not-disturb while you play, and a foreground GPU VRAM claim so a local model yields the memory.

plugins.name: pet
plugins.description: A creature that lives on the desktop, goes wherever you drag it, wanders its own patch of it, wears the theme, and reacts when you click it.

plugins.name: openrgb
plugins.description: Syncs the theme accent to RGB PC lighting over OpenRGB's SDK, and reacts to the Gaming profile and live AI-agent sessions.

plugins.name: direnv
plugins.description: Notifies you when a project opened from the launcher has an .envrc, so you know to review/allow it.

plugins.name: workspace-session-log
plugins.description: Keeps a local, timestamped log of when each Workspace Profile is launched.

plugins.name: claude-hooks
plugins.description: Wires Claude Code into Aphotic's agent-hook contract for live per-session tracking in the bar/dashboard, and claims the statusLine slot to read quota windows.

plugins.name: codex-hooks
plugins.description: Wires Codex into Aphotic's agent-hook contract for live per-session tracking in the bar/dashboard, same contract as Claude Code.

plugins.name: opencode-hooks
plugins.description: Wires OpenCode into Aphotic's agent-hook contract for live per-session tracking in the bar/dashboard, same contract as Claude Code.

plugins.name: visualizer
plugins.description: An audio spectrum that sits on the wallpaper, painted in the live theme accent and asleep whenever nothing is playing.

plugins.name: deep-signal
plugins.description: An idle screensaver: the wordmark resolves out of noise like a signal surfacing from deep water, over a sparse drift of bioluminescent particles. Takes its colours from whatever theme is active.
